data.name: Neekan
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-k-n', which means 'to move, shift, or migrate'. The name Neekan signifies gracefulness and elegance, evoking images of gentle movement and fluidity. In Islamic history, this name is associated with the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his migration from Mecca to Medina.
